title: US PPI Cools More Than Expected, Easing Pressure on Fed
title_cn: 美国PPI降幅超预期，缓解美联储压力
summary: US wholesale inflation decelerated in July by more than estimated as energy and food costs fell, likely giving the Federal Reserve more time to assess price pressures at upcoming meetings. Initial jobless claims rose by  9,000 in the week ending August 9. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Uses AI to Stop China's Transshipment Network
title_cn: 特朗普利用人工智能阻止中国的转运网络
summary: White House trade adviser Peter Navarro says the Trump administration is using artificial intelligence to crack down on countries that are helping China avoid tariffs imposed on them by the US. He says more than 40 countries are part of China's transshipment network. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
